name: Kanturu Relics
note: Kanturu Relics, MU's map 38 (client Data/World39 + Object39, MuMain's WD_38KANTURU_2ND), Season 2 (2006), entered from the Ruins' Relics door (gate 129 to 130). An indoor-reading refinery maze in a flat 1.70 m floor: pale stone corridors lit bright down their middle, scaffolds and 29 m tank columns hung into the black round them. Step 1, 2026-10-21: the bare land, with no `rules` yet, so the realm does not know the map. docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md Part B 8.1.

spawn.note: OpenMU's spawn gate 137 (VersionSeasonSix Gates.cs:283): the safe hall by the Ruins' door, where a death in the Relics or the boss map stands up. docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md Part A 2.1.

hidden.note: The Relics' emitter boxes (MoveKanturu2ndObject, GM_Kanturu_2nd.cpp:252-268): clouds, void glows, waterfall specks, water and thunder joints, every one an angeflo_R box drawn by no mesh. docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md Part B 8.1.

void.note: The Ruins' numbers for a first look: 42.0% of the map is NoGround round the maze, and the cho_scarp scaffolds hang 6-9.5 m into it. Ours, to judge in the first shot.

void_fill.note: From the safe hall (spawn gate 137). The maze is one region of 4,454 tiles; the 75 stray open tiles on rows 250-251 become void. Ours.
